facts.claim: Norwegian Joy (Norwegian Cruise Line): Entered service 2017; 167,725 GT; 3804 guests (lower berth / double occupancy); 323 m length; Breakaway Plus class.
Norwegian Joy is a Breakaway Plus-class cruise ship operated by Norwegian Cruise Line (NCL) and is the second of four Breakaway Plus-class vessels in the company's fleet.

catalogSpecs.description: Originally built for China, renovated in 2019 and again in 2024.
